canonical_name: International Medical Aid (IMA) High School Healthcare Internship
organizer_domain_provenance: medicalaid.org is the organizer's own primary domain
country: Kenya, Peru (flagship sites); other destinations referenced
citizenship_restrictions: Not explicitly stated; the program is structured around students of any home country traveling TO a host country (Kenya/Peru), so a student's own nationality/citizenship is not the operative eligibility axis in the way it is for a US-hosted program. Direct confirmation pages (medicalaid.org/internships/high-school/ and the fees page) returned HTTP 403 to automated fetching this session, so this is not independently first-party-confirmed.
turkey_access_reasoning: Structurally different from US/UK-hosted programs: this is a travel-to-a-third-country (Kenya or Peru) shadowing placement, so the usual 'US citizen only' pattern found throughout this research pass does not apply the same way. A Turkish student would need to independently arrange visas for Kenya/Peru (both of which are generally more accessible to Turkish passport holders than a US visa) plus program cost. Marked ELIGIBLE_WITH_CONDITIONS on the strength of the program's structure and secondary-source confirmation of global reach, but the organizer's own eligibility page could not be directly fetched this session (403) - genuinely less confirmed than the VERIFIED_ELIGIBLE/most-confident records in this batch.
age_range_verbatim: minimum age 16, confirmed via secondary-source summary of the organizer's own page
cost_note: Only a partial figure could be confirmed: a '$950 program deposit... required within fourteen days of initial acceptance' (per secondary-source summary of the organizer's own program-deposit page). The TOTAL program fee (deposit is explicitly only a portion) could NOT be confirmed - the dedicated fees page (medicalaid.org/internships/program-dates-fees/) returned HTTP 403 to automated fetching on two attempts. Recording the $950 as a known partial figure, NOT the full cost - do not present $950 as the total price.
award_or_output: In-person hospital shadowing, community health outreach, and structured clinical rotations at partner sites in Kenya or Peru, lasting 2-12 weeks (most participants choose at least 4 weeks) per secondary-source summary of the organizer's own program page.
current_cycle_label: rolling, summer and gap-year cycles per secondary summary
research_notes: WEAKEST-EVIDENCED internship-category record in this batch - direct fetches of both the high-school-specific page and the fees page were blocked (403) this session, so key facts (full cost, explicit international-eligibility clause, exact age cutoff) rest on secondary-source summaries of the organizer's own pages rather than a directly-rendered official quote. Included because it is structurally one of the very few genuine in-person clinical/healthcare INTERNSHIP (not mentored paper-writing) candidates found in the entire research pass, and because the Kenya/Peru destination structure sidesteps the US-visa bottleneck that disqualified most other internship leads. Flagged explicitly for re-verification by a session with working access to medicalaid.org before being treated as more than a strong lead.
